data.name: Nuh
data.gender_notes: Nuh is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Noaḥ, from the root n-w-ḥ, 'rest, comfort' (Genesis 5:29). Its root is Hebrew n-w-ḥ. The prophet Nūḥ (Noah); Sūrat Nūḥ in the Qur'an. Nuh is a Arabic name meaning “Rest; comfort”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nuh expresses “Rest; comfort”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Noaḥ, from the root n-w-ḥ, 'rest, comfort' (Genesis 5:29).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuh total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
